mechanism.claim: When the final three canonical blocks use more distinct raw first-coinbase-output script fingerprints than the first three while their completed-minute BTC returns share one strict sign, block-producer reward routing has broadened during directional price discovery; follow that common direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of confirmation-interval returns 4, 5, and 6
mechanism.why_distinct: CLCBRD uses the immutable raw script bytes of the first coinbase transaction output, an object absent from prior block cadence, size, weight, transaction-count, fee, endpoint, UTXO, witness, difficulty, and price-path candidates. The retired Mempool block-summary transport froze no alpha and explicitly left a separately frozen transaction-level panel as future work. CLCBRD does not repair that incomplete summary field and promotes no prior control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: a rapid broadening of confirmed reward-routing templates concurrent with one-way block-time repricing identifies heterogeneous block-production settlement during volatile discovery; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: height-modulo anchors, six transaction-level coinbase script fingerprints, late return unanimity, and six-hour reservation form a sparse asynchronous clock

features.anchor: canonical height H divisible by 36; ladder is blocks H through H+6
features.ladder_intervals: six strictly increasing header-timestamp intervals (H+k-1,H+k], each 60 to 1800 seconds
features.completed_minutes: for each interval use exact complete UTC perpetual minutes whose opens are >=ceil(left/60)*60 and whose closes are <=floor(right/60)*60
features.interval_return: R_k=log(last completed-minute close/first completed-minute open), finite and strict nonzero
features.coinbase_transaction: transaction index zero in each canonical block H+k; require exactly one coinbase input and at least one output
features.first_output: V_k is output index zero; require positive integer satoshi value and non-empty even-length canonical lowercase scriptpubkey hex
features.script_fingerprint: F_k=SHA256(raw bytes decoded from V_k.scriptpubkey); clear script bytes, ASM, address, pool label, and coinbase tag are never persisted
features.late_unanimity: R_4,R_5,R_6 have one common strict sign
features.eligible_state: late unanimity and routing-diversity broadening are both true
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding valid anchor state false; invalid anchors preserve prior valid state
features.confirmation: block H+6 and all six coinbase transactions are contained before signal availability
features.raw_availability: prefix maximum header timestamp and mediantime through H+6 plus 7200 seconds
features.decision: raw availability ceiled to the next exact five-minute UTC boundary D
features.source_valid: contiguous canonical chain, exact transaction-index proof, valid first output, and exact coherent perpetual minute grid; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.late_unanimity_only: late-three return unanimity onset without routing-diversity broadening
definitions.routing_diversity_only: D_L>D_E onset without late-three unanimity; side is sign(L)
definitions.one_anchor_stale_ladder: primary valid-anchor state and side shifted one anchor before onset

coinbase_transactions.primary: Blockstream Esplora GET /api/block/{block_hash}/txs/0 for only the six blocks belonging to selected height-modulo anchors
coinbase_transactions.secondary: Mempool Esplora GET /api/block/{block_hash}/txs/0 for every 257th selected block in increasing height order, requiring at least 64 checks
coinbase_transactions.agreement: block identity, transaction index zero, coinbase-input proof, first-output value, and raw scriptpubkey bytes must agree exactly

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no fingerprint, block predicate, diversity relation, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, transport, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
